text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft's Trainer made a suggestion 
regarding her debut race: how about the 
Turf 1400m at Kyoto Racecourse?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was thrilled by the proposal! After 
all, it was the very same course where her 
idol, the Tiara Umamusume Sweep Tosho, had 
made her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho ran like pure magic. Just like 
her, I want to run in a way that makes 
everyone's hearts flutter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Brimming with motivation, Rhein Kraft 
prepared to tackle her Make Debut.
